Transforming sales and service at scale

Connecting customer experience, commercial performance and delivery.

The objective

Help major insurance businesses improve sales and service performance through global contact-centre transformation.

Mak’s contribution

Across several assignments, Mak led work combining customer experience, customer-relationship systems, AI and automation, technology solutions and organizational change. The programmes included managed-services arrangements exceeding $100 million.

The outcome

The CV reports approximately 30% cost optimization and 18% revenue improvement across the cited work. These figures need to be associated with their respective assignments before use as individual case results.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Shaping large commercial undertakings and connecting business transformation with sustained delivery.
